body:
taylor calling olivia dean's The Art of Loving and rosalía's LUX "two perfect albums" has me grinning 🤍 she keeps going back to both, and says we connect to them because they're human. olivia's is "a warm hug," in her words

critique.rationale: Taylor naming Olivia Dean's The Art of Loving and Rosalía's LUX as her two perfect albums of the year, with the 'warm hug' line, is warm, sourced and of-the-moment. X leads on the quote; the 2007 Commons live photo is a real, credited shot but only loosely tied.

why: Event draft for intake #6870: at a virtual awards-season press conference for 'I Knew It, I Knew You' (Nov 13), Taylor named Olivia Dean's The Art of Loving and Rosalía's LUX her favorite albums of the year (inmusicblog, Geo.tv, qconciertos; setting per HELLO!). Parenting/iPad remark deliberately left out (family/minors blocklist). Fills 11-15 (no beat filled that day; 11-14 is taken by the CMA news pair, which never yields). Photo is the run's reserved eventPhoto, same on both halves; credit sits on IG, X too short for it.
